messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "children with other types of hypercholesterolemia"
set: ["children with other types of hypercholesterolemia", "people with certain types of cancer", "primary hypercholesterolemia", "different diabetes types", "people with certain types of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)", "children 8 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "children 7 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)", "blocking several receptor types", "interactions with other medicines", "keep this and all other medicines out of the reach of children", "children of any age", "children younger than 8 years of age with HeFH", "children younger than 7 years of age with HoFH", "people with other risk factors", "other forms of arthritis", "risk of potassium overdose when combined with other products"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
